mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is a misconception about chemical properties?

options.A: Boiling point of water is a chemical property.
options.B: Ability of iron to rust in moist air is a chemical property.
options.C: Density of copper is a physical property.
options.D: Color of gold is a physical property.

mcqs.answer: Boiling point of water is a chemical property.
mcqs.explanation: Boiling point is a physical property because it describes a change of state without altering chemical composition. Rusting involves a chemical reaction with oxygen, making it a chemical property. Density and color are also physical properties. Hence option A is the misconception.

mcqs.question: A piece of chalk is heated and turns into a white powder, while an iron nail left in moist air develops a reddish coating. Which reasoning correctly explains why the rusting of iron is a chemical change but the heating of chalk is a physical change?

options.A: Rusting forms a new substance (iron oxide), whereas heating chalk only changes its temperature.
options.B: Rusting involves a change in state, while heating chalk changes its composition.
options.C: Both processes produce new substances, but rusting is faster.
options.D: Heating chalk releases gas, whereas rusting does not.

mcqs.answer: Rusting forms a new substance (iron oxide), whereas heating chalk only changes its temperature.
mcqs.explanation: A chemical change results in new substances with different chemical composition. Rusting converts iron (Fe) to iron oxide (Fe₂O₃), a new compound. Heating chalk (calcium carbonate) may cause loss of water of crystallization but the substance remains calcium carbonate; no new chemical species are formed, so it is a physical change. Option A captures this distinction.

mcqs.learning_point: Classify matter into elements, compounds and mixtures
mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly matches the type of matter with its defining characteristic?

options.A: Element – composed of two or more different atoms chemically bonded together.
options.B: Compound – can be separated into its constituent elements by physical methods.
options.C: Mixture – has a uniform composition throughout the sample.
options.D: Compound – consists of two or more elements chemically combined in a fixed ratio.

mcqs.answer: Compound – consists of two or more elements chemically combined in a fixed ratio.
mcqs.explanation: An element contains only one kind of atom. A compound is formed when two or more elements combine chemically in a definite proportion, and it cannot be separated into its elements by physical means. Mixtures may be homogeneous or heterogeneous, but they are not defined by a fixed composition. Therefore, option D correctly describes a compound.

mcqs.question: A sample contains finely powdered sugar mixed uniformly with powdered milk. Which statement is true regarding this mixture?

options.A: It is a heterogeneous mixture because the two components can be seen with the naked eye.
options.B: It is a homogeneous mixture because its composition is uniform throughout the sample.
options.C: It is a heterogeneous mixture because sugar and milk have different chemical formulas.
options.D: It is a homogeneous mixture only after the mixture is dissolved in water.

mcqs.answer: It is a homogeneous mixture because its composition is uniform throughout the sample.
mcqs.explanation: When two fine powders are mixed thoroughly, the resulting mixture appears uniform at the macroscopic level, qualifying it as a homogeneous (or uniform) mixture. Visibility of individual particles or differing chemical formulas does not make it heterogeneous. Option B correctly identifies the mixture as homogeneous.

mcqs.question: Which of the following best defines matter?

options.A: Anything that occupies space and has mass.
options.B: Only solid substances that can be seen.
options.C: Energy that can be measured in joules.
options.D: A substance that can undergo chemical reactions.

mcqs.answer: Anything that occupies space and has mass.
mcqs.explanation: Matter is defined as anything that has mass and takes up space (volume). Solids, liquids, gases, and plasma all satisfy this definition. Energy, visibility, or reactivity alone do not define matter. Hence option A is correct.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a chemical property of a substance?
mcqs.explanation: Chemical properties describe how a substance interacts with other substances to form new products. Reactivity with acid involves a chemical reaction, making it a chemical property. Melting point, density, and color are physical properties because they do not involve a change in chemical identity.

mcqs.question: Which of the following processes is a chemical change?

options.D: Breaking a glass rod into two pieces

mcqs.explanation: A chemical change results in new substances with different chemical compositions. Burning a candle converts wax (hydrocarbons) into carbon dioxide, water vapor, and other gases—new substances. Melting, dissolving, and breaking are physical changes where the original substances remain unchanged.

mcqs.learning_point: Classify matter into elements, compounds and mixtures
mcqs.question: Identify the correct classification for each of the following: (i) Oxygen gas (O₂), (ii) Table salt (NaCl), (iii) Air.
mcqs.explanation: O₂ consists of only oxygen atoms, making it an element. NaCl is formed from sodium and chlorine atoms chemically bonded in a fixed ratio, so it is a compound. Air contains various gases (nitrogen, oxygen, argon, etc.) that are not chemically combined, thus it is a mixture. Option A correctly classifies all three.
